title: Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions Cancellation, Commitment and Transfer Schedule
content:
The figures that govern ending a Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions product — the full-refund window, refunds of an up-front price after that window, the monthly commitment and its early termination fee, the cancellation that follows a failed installment, and transfer to another person — are the same for all six subscriptions.

| Subscription | Unused subscription fully refunded when cancelled within this many calendar days after purchase | Up-front term cancelled after the window refunds unused full months | Installments owed before a monthly-billed subscription can end without the early termination fee | Early termination fee (USD) | Calendar days after a failed monthly installment after which the subscription is cancelled | Transferable to another person |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Bag Pass One | 14 | No | 12 | 99 | 15 | No |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | 14 | No | 12 | 99 | 15 | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | 14 | No | 12 | 99 | 15 | No |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | 14 | No | 12 | 99 | 15 | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | 14 | No | 12 | 99 | 15 | No |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | 14 | No | 12 | 99 | 15 | No |

## Questions the schedule answers

**Does any subscription refund unused full months of an up-front price after the full-refund window?**
No. The entry reads No for all six subscriptions.

**How many monthly installments does the commitment require, and what is the fee for ending sooner?**
12 installments for every subscription; the early termination fee is 99 USD for every subscription.

**How long may a monthly installment remain failed before the subscription is cancelled?**
15 calendar days, for every subscription.

**May a subscription be transferred to another person?**
No subscription is transferable.
